title: Buzz: free Otter alternative
caption:
Otter charges $100/year to turn speech into text. Buzz does it for free 🎙

✅ Transcribes audio and video files, with timestamps
✅ Live transcription from your microphone
✅ Exports to TXT, SRT and VTT, and can translate
✅ Runs offline on your computer, no subscription

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ New Mac versions need Apple silicon (Intel Macs stop at 1.4.5), the first run downloads a Whisper model, and the Windows installer is unsigned ("More info" → "Run anyway"). Otter Pro's $100/year is the annual plan; monthly it's $16.99

Comment "BUZZ" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
